pages.title: Empirical Notes II
pages.text: The second third of my empirical record: psionic crystals, attosecond capacitors, strange and charm quarks, quaternions and the complex plane, tachyon klystrons. It is the most chaotic volume, the one where physics and mathematics start to bleed into each other on the page.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Assembling the second volume showed me how much of my early work was really mathematics in disguise. A quaternion crystal and the complex plane sat beside quarks and a tachyon klystron, and the Femtoscale line wove them into one coherent set of notes.
